summary: The pinned screen mini-player is now composed between the workspace content and scrim/drawer/search overlays, matching the web z-order. In compact layouts it is anchored to the expanded content area directly above the voice dock. Hidden mini-player controls are excluded from focus and semantics while navigation/search overlays are open.
